title: Free two-term cover of a complex
statement: Let $A$ be a ring and let $M^\bullet$ be a cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. There exists a morphism $Q^\bullet \to M^\bullet$ that is degreewise surjective and surjective on cocycles in every degree, together with a degreewise split short exact sequence of complexes $0 \to Q'^\bullet \to Q^\bullet \to Q''^\bullet \to 0$ in which $Q'^\bullet$ and $Q''^\bullet$ are direct sums of shifts $A[k]$ with zero differential.

proof.text: For every degree n and every element m of M^n, take a copy T(n,m) of the two-term complex A[−n] → A[−n−1] (free of rank one in degrees n and n+1, with the shift convention N[k]^j=N^{j+k}) whose differential is the identity, and map its lower generator (degree n) to m and its upper generator (degree n+1) to d_M(m). These maps define a morphism T(n,m) → M because d_M^2=0. Let Q_0 be the termwise direct sum of all T(n,m), over all n and m, with the map to M given summand by summand. The resulting map Q_0 → M is degreewise surjective, since the lower generator indexed by any m maps to m.

For every degree n and every cocycle z in Z^n(M)=ker(d_M:M^n→M^{n+1}), add a copy S(n,z) of the zero-differential shift A[−n] (A concentrated in degree n), mapped to M by sending its generator to z; this is a morphism of complexes because d_M(z)=0. Let Q be the termwise direct sum Q_0 ⊕ (⊕ S(n,z)), with the induced map to M. The generator of S(n,z) is a cocycle of Q mapping to z, so Z^n(Q) → Z^n(M) is surjective for every n, while degreewise surjectivity is retained from Q_0.

Let Q' be the direct sum of all upper terms A[−n−1] in the T(n,m), together with all S(n,z), and let Q'' be the direct sum of all lower terms A[−n] in the T(n,m). The upper terms and the S(n,z) are subcomplexes of Q (their differentials are zero), so Q' → Q is an inclusion of complexes, and Q'' = Q/Q' carries the zero differential. Degreewise Q = Q' ⊕ Q'' as modules, so 0 → Q' → Q → Q'' → 0 is a degreewise split short exact sequence of complexes, and Q', Q'' are direct sums of shifts A[k] with zero differential, as required.

lean.statement: theorem exists_freeComplexCover {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) : ∃ (S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)) (f : S.X₂ ⟶ M), (∀ n : ℤ, Function.Surjective (f.f n)) ∧ (∀ (n : ℤ) (z : M.X n), M.d n (n + 1) z = 0 → ∃ x : S.X₂.X n, S.X₂.d n (n + 1) x = 0 ∧ f.f n x = z) ∧ S.ShortExact ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty (S.map (HomologicalComplex.eval (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n)).Splitting) ∧ ∃ (I₁ I₃ : Type u) (d₁ : I₁ → ℤ) (d₃ : I₃ → ℤ), Nonempty (S.X₁ ≅ ∐ (fun i : I₁ => (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (d₁ i)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))) ∧ Nonempty (S.X₃ ≅ ∐ (fun i : I₃ => (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (d₃ i)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A)))

reviewed_lean.note: A commutative ring ([Ring] -> [CommRing], Stacks convention), M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat A) Z; f : S.X2 -> M degreewise surjective; cocycle lift x with d x = 0, f x = z; S.ShortExact with each degree split via eval; S.X1, S.X3 iso to coproducts of single (ModuleCat.of A A) in degrees d_i (zero differential, empty index allowed); docstring has the 3 proof steps; no Mathlib/source match (source FreeComplex.lean is finite free complexes); unused EpiMono import removed
